data.one_liner: Pure Dart wrapper for Firebase Authentication REST API, works on all Dart platforms.
data.what_it_does: Provides high‑level classes to sign up, sign in, manage users and refresh tokens via Firebase's REST endpoints. Also exposes low‑level REST classes for direct API calls.
use_when: You need Firebase Auth without native SDKs or platform channels
You target platforms where the official firebase_auth plugin isn’t supported (e.g., pure Dart, server, or web without JS)
You want to run authentication against the Firebase emulator
avoid_when: You already use the official firebase_auth plugin with native SDKs
You need deep integration with Google Sign‑In or Apple Sign‑In that rely on platform SDKs
strengths: Works on all Dart platforms including server and CLI
No native code or platform‑specific setup required
Supports parallel logins and automatic token refresh
weaknesses: Limited to REST features; no real‑time token revocation handling
Less mature than the official firebase_auth plugin
Relies on manual handling of API keys and security rules

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official plugin with native SDK support, richer feature set, and tighter integration with Firebase services
